notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Shivan Wurm by paying {R}{G}.
Birgi, Animar and Tangleroot trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot and Birgi triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shivan Wurm enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
